evals.name: cold-start
evals.prompt: morning — what do I need to do today?
evals.expected_output: First run: creates a tracker, produces a prioritized brief across Notion, GitHub and Calendar with links, puts ancient PRs in Close-or-revive, writes tracker rows + log entry.
assertions: Brief covers all three sources (Calendar, GitHub, Notion) or names any source that was unavailable
Brief opens with a 'Top 3' synthesis for today
Every Notion page and GitHub item named in the brief is linked
The 1100+-day-old spark-utils#37 PR is not in the Top 3 and is placed in a close-or-revive style bucket
Brief is 60 lines or fewer
A private tracker page was created holding only flagged items (12 or fewer Watching entries, not every owned initiative)
A log entry dated 2026-11-06 was written to the tracker page
ade-bench#68 (unanswered 'can this be closed?' question) is surfaced as waiting on Vince

evals.name: diff-against-history
evals.prompt: catch me up, what am I letting slip?
evals.expected_output: Uses seeded tracker: flags LICENSE PR as repeat offender (5th time), marks dbt-checks#3 resolved after verifying it closed, keeps 'Webinars and blog posts' in Rotting, excludes the dismissed 'Segment customers' item, updates counts.
assertions: dbt-lint-yaml#59 (LICENSE PR) is called out as a repeat offender / flagged multiple times
dbt-checks#3 is reported as resolved/closed (verified, not assumed)
Dismissed item 'Segment customers by V2 migration readiness' does not appear in the brief
'Webinars and blog posts' appears under rotting / slipping
Tracker updated: #59 flagged 5 and dbt-checks#3 removed from Watching
Every Notion page and GitHub item named in the brief is linked
ade-bench#68 (unanswered 'can this be closed?' question) is surfaced as waiting on Vince

evals.name: webinar-prep
evals.prompt: I've got the v2 community webinar coming up — give me my headsup but tell me what I need to prep.
evals.expected_output: Brief that connects calendar events to the Notion webinar pages (Webinar Brief: dbt v2 Community, Webinars and blog posts, workback plan) and lists concrete prep items.
assertions: Brief links the Notion webinar planning pages (Webinar Brief: dbt v2 Community and/or the workback plan)
Brief lists at least 3 concrete webinar prep items
Brief states the webinar's calendar date/time, or explicitly says it is not on the calendar
Brief still includes a Top 3 / general headsup beyond the webinar
Every Notion page and GitHub item named in the brief is linked
